hlg_0fb0dc543542f24e_001.rationale: llg_001 enables users to define specific, measurable fitness goals such as weight loss targets or workout frequency; llg_002 enables real-time progress tracking with alerts, which complements goal definition by providing feedback mechanisms. Together, they form a complete scope of goal-setting and monitoring, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.
hlg_0fb0dc543542f24e_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to define personalized fitness goals and track their progress with real-time alerts and notifications.

hlg_3b3cb63beecf40e0_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to guide new users through core app features via interactive walkthroughs or videos, while llg_002 adds the capability to recommend low-intensity, beginner-appropriate workouts. Together, they form a complete scope of user onboarding and initial activity guidance, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.
hlg_3b3cb63beecf40e0_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Onboard new users and guide them through beginner-friendly fitness activities using interactive tutorials and personalized workout suggestions.

hlg_7a7c9f5728034832_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to record detailed workout session data including duration, intensity, and equipment used. llg_002 adds the capability to visualize activity trends over time using graphs and charts for metrics like calories burned, distance covered, or workout frequency. Together, they form a complete scope of logging and visualizing fitness data, with no inferred or generalized functionality beyond these two distinct capabilities.
hlg_7a7c9f5728034832_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to log workout session data and visualize activity trends over time through graphical representations of progress metrics.

hlg_8d667b8f3c5217c4_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to generate an initial personalized workout plan based on user’s fitness level, preferences, and past performance. llg_002 adds the capability to recommend workouts and adjust existing plans as the user’s fitness level improves or plateaus — indicating a dynamic, iterative adaptation capability that extends beyond static plan generation.
hlg_8d667b8f3c5217c4_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Generate and dynamically adapt personalized workout plans based on user fitness level, preferences, past performance, and ongoing progress.

hlg_b2b4ce58b73e128a_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to design a simplified UI for new users, focusing on minimalism and ease of navigation. llg_002 adds the capability to enable advanced customization for experienced users, including toggling views and adjusting chart granularity — which introduces a materially different user experience and control scope than llg_001. Together, they define a dual-mode interface with distinct lifecycle phases and actor-specific configurations, with no inferred missing functionality.
hlg_b2b4ce58b73e128a_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide a dual-mode user interface that supports both novice and expert users through distinct visual configurations and interactive controls.
